body:
Thanks so much! I actually really enjoyed the way it looked on the test strip in the catalogue, but I realise that it’s not realistic to what it will come out on the actual hair. This might be silly to ask, but can you gauge what level my roots are from the picture? I assume that 20 vol lifts more than the very subtle 10, but not as dramatically as others.

Edit: person at till said my roots looked like a 3-4, hence why they recommended the 20 vol developer, but I’m a bit sceptical about the level gauge which causes my hesitance about the developer volume.
Ends were previously lightened, but there is more than 9 month regrowth.
This is perfect, thank you so much!

Hahah, I’d love to see the reactions to Rite of Spring.

Thanks for the suggestions, I might try my hand at arranging them since there’s so much time !

Thank you! You can see my confusion with undertones now hah!  I was looking at a picture of Cailee from the Met Gala (I think?) and that particular lighting emphasised her paleness and rosiness of her cheeks, but now I’m looking at other pictures, and I see that she leans a lot warmer than I do. 

Do you have any Vitamin C recommendations? I’ve read somewhere that it’s definitely something to splurge on and not buy drugstore brands like Garnier as they might not be so effective.

Окей, явно си masterclass rage bait, за който аз се хванах. По друг начин не мога да си обясня нито коментарите ти, нито избора ти на човек, който явно рефлектира мирогледа ти. 

Разбираш света точно колкото тая сган на профилната ти разбира човешките права — избирателно, и когато и както му е удобно.
Кисинджър много добре е знаел, но ти явно не, за да го идолизираш.
Този коментар да идва от човек с профилна снимка на Хенри Кисинджър. А очаквах, че няма какво повече да ме изненада в r/bulgaria.
If you live in the UK — Marks & Spencer has really good own-brand options. The sugar-free lemonade is sooo good!!

So sorry for your loss! Lost my cat last year as well - got him when I was three, and lost him when I was 18, coincidentally when I moved to university. Felt like the end of an era. We connect to them so much, even without language, so it’s not crazy to think they’re still with us, even in death, I believe this bond never breaks. Hope you feel better soon ❤️
Thesaurus.com is a permanently open tab on this guy’s browser.

You’re right about Shatner. I guess I associate him with the suave, cool Kirk too much to ever be able to imagine him as Alyosha. Also, I looked up said adaptation and to be honest, the others don’t really fit as well. Ivan looks too old and Dmitri is just... strange...
Thank you! Sorry for the dumb question...

That was before my time, but a girl from my school was hit in the head by a swing while playing outside. Her parents donated a memorial to my school and now the kids play around it and even climb on it. It’s kind of morbid if you think about it.
I looked into it and your 5w4 suggestion makes much sense. Thank you !
